airspace.zh: 摩洛哥對無人機管制嚴格：進口須事先取得許可（由內政部審核），一般只核准政府機關、公司與公共機構；未經許可進口或使用的無人機會被沒收。觀光客請勿攜帶無人機入境。
airspace.en: Morocco controls drones strictly: imports need prior authorization (reviewed by the Ministry of the Interior), generally granted only to administrations, companies and public bodies; drones imported or flown without authorization are seized. Visitors should not bring drones.

ksar.note: fortified earthen village on a hillside by the Ounila River

studios.note: film studio founded 1983, about 5 km west of Ouarzazate

title.en: An Earthen Town on the Caravan Road

tagline.zh-Hant: 撒哈拉與馬拉喀什之間的貿易站，與一座被慢慢搬空的築壘村
tagline.en: A trading post between the Sahara and Marrakesh, and a fortified village slowly left behind

zh: 摩洛哥東南部，翁尼拉河畔的山坡上，
土色的房子一層層往上疊。
en: In south-eastern Morocco, on a hillside by the Ounila River,
earth-coloured houses climb in layers.

zh: 這是阿伊特本哈杜，
一座以高牆圍起的築壘村，稱為「克薩」。
en: This is Ait-Ben-Haddou,
a ksar: a group of earthen buildings inside high walls.

zh: 它位在高亞特拉斯山南坡的山腳下，
屬於瓦爾扎扎特省。
en: It lies in the foothills on the southern slopes of the High Atlas,
in the Province of Ouarzazate.

zh: 它是古代商路上的貿易站之一，
連接撒哈拉以南與馬拉喀什。
en: It was one of many trading posts on the route
linking the lands south of the Sahara with Marrakesh.

zh: 商隊經德拉河谷，
再翻越特盧埃特山口北上。
en: Caravans came by the Drâa Valley
and crossed the Atlas by the Tizi-n'Telouet pass.

zh: 十一世紀的穆拉比特王朝時，
這裡就已經築起防禦。
en: The site was fortified
as early as the eleventh century, under the Almoravids.

zh: 但現存的建築，
最早不早於十七世紀。
en: But none of the buildings standing today
is thought to be older than the seventeenth century.

zh: 房屋緊挨在防禦牆內，
牆角立著塔樓。
en: The houses crowd inside defensive walls
reinforced by corner towers.

zh: 1987年，它列入世界遺產，
核心區只有三點零三公頃。
en: It was inscribed as World Heritage in 1987;
its core area is just 3.03 hectares.

zh: 後來大多數居民搬到河對岸的新村，
老村只剩幾戶人家。
en: Most residents later moved to the new village across the river;
only a few families remain in the old ksar.

zh: 2011年，一座人行橋完工，
連起老村與新村。
en: In 2011 a footbridge was completed
linking the old ksar and the new village.

zh: 2023年9月的地震，
讓部分建築出現裂縫與局部倒塌。
en: The earthquake of September 2023
left cracks and partial collapses.

zh: 無人維護的土造房子很脆弱，
這是遺產保存最大的難題。
en: Earthen buildings that nobody maintains are very vulnerable;
that is the hardest problem for their care.

zh: 商隊不再經過，
土牆仍記得這條路曾經多麼熱鬧。
en: The caravans no longer pass,
but the earthen walls still recall how busy this road once was.

title.en: A Village of Earth, and a Film Set

tagline.zh-Hant: 清真寺、廣場、糧倉、墓地，以及瓦爾扎扎特的電影業
tagline.en: Mosque, square, granary and cemeteries, and the film industry of Ouarzazate

zh: 從空中看，整座村落是一個緊密的整體，
封閉而懸在山坡上。
en: From the air the village is one compact whole,
closed and hanging on the hillside.

zh: 有些房子小而樸素，
有些像帶著高塔的小城堡。
en: Some houses are modest;
others are like small urban castles with high corner towers.

zh: 村裡有清真寺與公共廣場，
城牆外是打穀場。
en: Inside are a mosque and a public square;
outside the ramparts are threshing floors.

zh: 山頂是防禦工事與存糧的倉房，
俯瞰整座村落。
en: At the top of the hill stand a fortification and a loft
looking down over the village.

zh: 村外還有商隊旅舍、
穆斯林與猶太人的墓地。
en: Beyond are a caravanserai
and Muslim and Jewish cemeteries.

zh: 房子的上半部，
常用陶土磚砌出裝飾圖案。
en: The upper parts of the houses
are often decorated with motifs in clay brick.

zh: 建材至今仍是泥土與木頭，
想引進水泥的嘗試大多沒有成功。
en: The materials are still earth and wood;
attempts to bring in cement have mostly failed.

zh: 面向巷道的門窗，
仍用木頭而不用金屬。
en: Doors and windows facing the lanes
are still made of wood, not metal.

zh: 這座村落常被電影與電視劇選為外景地。
en: The ksar has been a location for many films and television series.

zh: 瓦爾扎扎特西邊約五公里，
是1983年成立的亞特拉斯電影製片廠。
en: About 5 km west of Ouarzazate
is Atlas Corporation Studios, founded in 1983.

zh: 以佔地來說，它被稱為世界最大的電影片場。
en: By land area it is described as the largest film studio in the world.

zh: 一項2020年的研究估計，
每年有二十到五十部外國影視作品在瓦爾扎扎特拍攝。
en: A 2020 study estimated that 20 to 50 foreign film and TV productions
are shot in Ouarzazate each year.

zh: 瓦爾扎扎特有「沙漠之門」的稱號，
2024年人口約七萬九千人。
en: Ouarzazate is called the "Door of the Desert";
in 2024 it had about 79,000 people.

zh: 一座土造的村落，
同時是生活的地方、遺產，也是攝影棚。
en: One earthen village:
a place to live, a heritage site and a film set.

title.en: A River at the Edge of the Desert

tagline.zh-Hant: 高亞特拉斯山腳的炎熱沙漠氣候、河谷綠洲與水庫
tagline.en: Hot desert climate at the foot of the High Atlas, a river oasis and a reservoir

zh: 翁尼拉河是一條窄窄的河，
從高亞特拉斯山腳流下來。
en: The Ounila is a narrow river
that runs down from the foothills of the High Atlas.

zh: 它在阿伊特本哈杜與伊米尼河會合。
en: At Ait-Ben-Haddou it joins the Imini River.

zh: 村落下方，是一片河谷綠洲。
en: Below the village lies a river oasis.

zh: 從上面看，綠色沿著河道分布，
兩側是乾燥的土地。
en: From above, the green follows the river,
with dry ground on both sides.

zh: 往東南是瓦爾扎扎特，
海拔一千一百五十一公尺。
en: To the south-east is Ouarzazate,
1,151 metres above sea level.

zh: 這裡是炎熱的沙漠氣候，
一年平均雨量只有一百一十五毫米。
en: The climate is hot desert,
with only 115 millimetres of rain a year on average.

zh: 七月的平均最高溫約三十九度，
最高紀錄四十四度。
en: The average July high is about 39 °C;
the record is 44 °C.

zh: 冬天卻很冷，
一月平均最低溫不到兩度。
en: Yet winters are cold:
the average January low is under 2 °C.

zh: 冷風從高亞特拉斯山吹下來，
偶爾還會下雪。
en: Icy winds blow down from the High Atlas,
and snow falls now and then.

zh: 流過市區的伊里里河，
是德拉河的支流。
en: The Assif Iriri, which crosses the town,
is a tributary of the Drâa.

zh: 市區以東，是曼蘇爾・埃達比水庫。
en: East of the town lies the El Mansour Eddahbi reservoir.

zh: 同樣的陽光，
在城北被收集來發電。
en: The same sunshine
is gathered north of the town to make electricity.

zh: 回到河谷，綠洲是這片乾地上少數的綠色。
en: Back in the valley, the oasis is some of the only green in this dry land.

zh: 一條小河，讓沙漠邊緣能有村落與田地。
en: One small river makes villages and fields possible at the edge of the desert.

tagline.zh-Hant: 用河谷泥土蓋房子，用沙漠陽光發電
tagline.en: Building with valley earth, generating power with desert sun

zh: 阿伊特本哈杜靠著山坡建造，
房屋一路堆到山頂。
en: Ait-Ben-Haddou is built against a hill,
its houses stacked up to the top.

zh: 建材是夯土、土坯、陶土磚與木頭。
en: It is built of rammed earth, adobe, clay brick and wood.

zh: 夯土是把泥土層層壓實而成；
高的房子一樓用夯土，上面改用較輕的土坯。
en: Rammed earth is soil packed hard in layers;
tall houses use it up to the first floor, then lighter adobe above.

zh: 這裡展示了南摩洛哥前撒哈拉地區
土造建築的完整技術。
en: The site shows a complete panorama
of pre-Saharan earthen building techniques.

zh: 德拉、托德拉、達德斯與蘇斯河谷的土造建築類型，
在這裡都看得到。
en: The main earthen building types of the Drâa, Todgha,
Dadès and Souss valleys can all be seen here.

zh: 往東南是瓦爾扎扎特盆地，
在高亞特拉斯山的南側。
en: To the south-east is the Ouarzazate basin,
on the southern side of the High Atlas.

zh: 瓦爾扎扎特市內的塔烏里爾特城堡，
也主要用夯土建造。
en: Ouarzazate's Taourirt Kasbah
is likewise built mainly of rammed earth.

zh: 城外約十公里，
是努爾太陽能電廠群。
en: About 10 km from the town
is the Noor solar complex.

zh: 電廠群佔地超過三千公頃，
分四期建成。
en: The complex covers more than 3,000 hectares
and was built in four phases.

zh: 一期用拋物槽集熱，一百六十百萬瓦，
2016年2月併網。
en: Phase I uses parabolic troughs, 160 megawatts,
connected to the grid in February 2016.

zh: 往北是三期，
用太陽能塔發電。
en: North of it is Phase III,
a solar tower plant.

zh: 這座塔高兩百五十公尺，
周圍的鏡面把陽光集中到塔頂。
en: The tower is 250 metres tall;
the mirrors around it focus sunlight on its top.

zh: 二期與三期，
都有七小時的熔鹽儲熱。
en: Phases II and III
each have seven hours of molten-salt storage.

zh: 同一片土地與陽光，
從夯土村落一路用到太陽能塔。
en: The same earth and the same sun,
from a rammed-earth village to a solar tower.
